Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
ON 4/15/2011 @ 10:00 AM WHILE FISHING THE CHARLES RIVER AT # 135 ELM STREET IN WALTHAM MASS I NOTICED A DEEP BLUE SHEEN OF OIL FLOWING INTO THE RIVER. I FOLLOWED THE SOURCE OF THE SHEEN AND SAW THAT IT WAS COMING FROM THE YARD OF BOSTON BARK CORP AND THEY WERE PRESSURE WASHING TRUCKS & HEAVY EQUIPMENT AT THAT TIME. THEIR YARD BORDERS THE RIVER AND THERE ARE NO DRAINS ON THIER PROPERTY AND ALL OF THE BACK WASH FLOWS RIGHT INTO THE RIVER. IT SEEMS AS THIS HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR A WHILE AS THE GROUND IS VERY DIRTY & OILY SMELLING WHERE IT FLOWS INTO THE RIVER. I WOULD HAVE TO SAY THAT THIS HAS A BIG IMPACT ON THE FISH & WILD LIFE THERE ON THE CHARLES RIVER.
